name: developer-harness
description: Language conventions, engineering-method skills, review checklists, diagram skills, command wrappers, agent role templates, and guard hooks for any codebase.

interface.longDescription: A batteries-included harness for coding agents: 26 skills plus nine guard hooks, usable in any codebase. Language skills cover Python, Rust, TypeScript, C#, and Java — conventions, API-design checklists, documentation and docstring standards, and expert developer personas. Method skills cover systematic debugging, multi-source deep research, plan stress-testing, feature builds, and skill authoring. Two architect skills run design-spec and codebase reviews against shared principles and produce diagram-backed HTML reports; mermaid-skill and gantt-roadmap generate diagrams and roadmaps directly. Role and team skills adopt agent role contracts and assemble delegation-first teams. The guard hooks block staged secrets, merge-conflict markers, oversized files, dangerous commands, and invisible-Unicode instruction injection, guard protected paths, and keep AGENTS.md chains inside the size budget agents actually read. Thirteen skills ship starter prompts for explicit $-invocation; review and orchestration pipelines are marked explicit-only so they never start from a description match alone.
defaultPrompt: Use $tighten-types to tighten type annotations in the given scope.
Use $architect-design-review to review the design spec at docs/design/spec.md.
Use $gantt-roadmap to turn this plan into a Gantt-chart roadmap.
